The kettle sings of rain before the rain comes down tonight.
The window holds a lamp for you when rain comes down tonight.

My mother kept the letters in a box of cedar wood.
She reads them to the empty chairs when rain comes down tonight.

The river knows the names of all the boats it carried out.
It says them slowly to the stones when rain comes down tonight.

I left a coat upon the gate, a cup upon the sill.
Who walks this road will find them there when rain comes down tonight.

You asked me, Vlo, what keeps a song alive in a dry year.
A promise, kept the way a field is kept, when rain comes down tonight.
